entities.name: MortgageApplication
entities.description: The core aggregate for a residential mortgage application. Created when a customer proceeds from enquiry to DIP (PH-010). Tracks the application lifecycle from initial enquiry through to completion. Owned exclusively by SVC-002.

fields.name: application_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated. Immutable after creation. Globally unique within SVC-002.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → Customer.customer_id (ENT-001, owned by SVC-001). Must reference an existing Customer record. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: property_address
fields.validation_rule: Required. Sub-object: line1 (required, max 100 chars), line2 (optional), city (required), county (optional), postcode (required, UK postcode format), country_code (required, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, must be GB for residential UK mortgage).

fields.name: purchase_price
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, max 2 decimal places, expressed in GBP. Must be > 0. Must be >= loan_amount + deposit_amount.

fields.name: deposit_amount
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, max 2 decimal places, expressed in GBP. Must be >= 5% of purchase_price (minimum deposit). deposit_amount + loan_amount must equal purchase_price.

fields.name: loan_amount
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, max 2 decimal places, expressed in GBP. Derived: purchase_price - deposit_amount. Must be <= 95% of purchase_price (max LTV). Immutable after PH-010 DIP unless customer amends.

fields.name: ltv_ratio
fields.validation_rule: Required. Computed: loan_amount / min(purchase_price, valuation_amount) × 100. Expressed as a percentage to 2 decimal places. Updated after valuation (PH-012) using valuation_amount if valuation_amount < purchase_price. Must be <= 95.00 for standard residential products.

fields.name: term_years
fields.validation_rule: Required. Integer. Minimum 5 years. Maximum 40 years. Must result in mortgage end date not exceeding the oldest applicant's 75th birthday (product policy).

fields.name: rate_type
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: fixed | variable | tracker. Immutable after DIP unless customer amends within the pre-application window.

fields.name: product_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. References the selected mortgage product from SVC-002 product catalogue. Must be a valid, currently active product_id. Product eligibility (LTV, income, property type) validated at DIP stage.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: enquiry | dip_pending | dip_issued | dip_expired | dip_declined | full_application_submitted | documents_complete | valuation_pending | valuation_complete | underwriting | approved | referred | declined | offer_issued | offer_accepted | offer_expired | completed | withdrawn. Transitions are strictly controlled by domain events. No backward transitions once 'completed'.

fields.name: application_type
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: purchase | remortgage | buy_to_let | shared_ownership. Determines affordability rules applied.

fields.name: dip_date
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when status transitions to 'dip_issued'. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). The date the DIP was issued.

fields.name: dip_expiry
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when dip_date is set. Computed: dip_date + 90 days. DIP is valid for 90 calendar days from issue. Application automatically transitions to 'dip_expired' if full_application_date is not set before dip_expiry.

fields.name: full_application_date
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when status transitions to 'full_application_submitted'. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be on or before dip_expiry.

fields.name: created_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Immutable.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Updated on any field mutation.

relationships.description: MortgageApplication belongs to one Customer via customer_id FK. Cross-service reference: ENT-001 is owned by SVC-001. SVC-002 holds customer_id only — no direct join. Customer data fetched via SVC-001 API when needed.
MortgageApplication may have multiple AffordabilityAssessment records (one at DIP, one at full application). Latest assessment is authoritative for underwriting.
MortgageApplication has one PropertyValuation record (created when valuation is instructed in PH-012).
MortgageApplication has at most one active MortgageOffer record (created after underwriting approval in PH-014).

design_decisions.decision: MortgageApplication is the aggregate root for the mortgage journey. All downstream entities (AffordabilityAssessment, PropertyValuation, MortgageOffer) reference application_id as their FK.
design_decisions.rationale: Consistent with DDD aggregate root pattern. All mortgage journey state changes are reflected through the MortgageApplication status machine. Single point of truth for application lifecycle.

design_decisions.decision: customer_id is stored as a plain UUID FK — SVC-002 does not store any Customer fields locally. Customer data is fetched from SVC-001 via direct API call (same-capability allowed per architecture rules).
design_decisions.rationale: Avoids data duplication. SVC-001 is the authoritative source for Customer data. Same-capability direct call (both in CAP-001) is architecturally permitted.

entities.name: AffordabilityAssessment
entities.description: Captures the results of an MCOB-compliant affordability assessment for a mortgage application. Created at DIP stage (PH-010) for the soft-check assessment, and again at full application (PH-011) for the binding affordability determination. The latest completed assessment is the authoritative record used by underwriting.

fields.name: assessment_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated. Immutable.

fields.name: application_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → MortgageApplication.application_id (ENT-012). Must reference an existing MortgageApplication. Immutable.

fields.name: assessment_stage
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: dip | full_application. Indicates whether this assessment was produced at DIP or full application stage.

fields.name: gross_income
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, max 2 decimal places, GBP per annum. At DIP stage: customer-declared. At full application: verified against income documents. Must be > 0.
fields.transparency_note: Used solely for affordability calculation. Stored under MCOB record-keeping obligation (7 years). Not surfaced to customer in raw form post-assessment.

fields.name: net_income
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, max 2 decimal places, GBP per annum. Must be <= gross_income. Derived from gross_income after estimated tax, NI, and pension deductions (or confirmed via payslips at full application stage).

fields.name: committed_expenditure
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal or 0.00, max 2 decimal places, GBP per month. Includes: existing loan repayments, credit card minimum payments, hire purchase, childcare costs. Sourced from credit bureau data and customer declaration. Must include stress-tested mortgage payment in the total.

fields.name: stress_test_rate
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal expressed as annual percentage rate (%). Must be >= max(initial_mortgage_rate + 3.0, 7.0) per MCOB 11.6.5. Immutable after assessment creation.

fields.name: monthly_payment_at_stress_rate
fields.validation_rule: Required. Computed monthly payment assuming stress_test_rate applied over full term_years. GBP, max 2 decimal places.

fields.name: affordability_result
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: pass | fail | marginal. 'pass': (net_income / 12) - committed_expenditure - monthly_payment_at_stress_rate > bank's minimum surplus threshold. 'fail': negative or below threshold. 'marginal': within 10% above threshold — flagged for underwriter review.

fields.name: assessor
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: automated | PER-055 | PER-051. 'automated' for system-generated assessments. Staff ID for manual or reviewed assessments.

fields.name: assessed_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Immutable.

relationships.description: AffordabilityAssessment belongs to one MortgageApplication via application_id FK.

design_decisions.decision: AffordabilityAssessment is created twice per application (once at DIP, once at full application) rather than updated in place. The full application assessment supersedes the DIP assessment for underwriting purposes.
design_decisions.rationale: MCOB record-keeping requires audit evidence of both the DIP-stage and full application-stage assessments. Immutable records support regulatory audit trail. Creates a clear historical record if income changes between DIP and full application.

entities.name: PropertyValuation
entities.description: Records the result of the property valuation instructed by the bank in PH-012. Captures the surveyor's assessed market value, valuation type, and status. The valuation_amount is the authoritative value used for LTV recalculation and underwriting.

fields.name: valuation_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated. Immutable.

fields.name: application_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → MortgageApplication.application_id (ENT-012). Immutable.

fields.name: property_address
fields.validation_rule: Required. Same structure as MortgageApplication.property_address. Must match the property_address on the parent MortgageApplication (cross-validated at creation).

fields.name: valuation_amount
fields.validation_rule: Required when status = 'completed'. Positive decimal, max 2 decimal places, GBP. The surveyor's assessed open market value. May differ from purchase_price. Triggers LTV recalculation on MortgageApplication when received.

fields.name: valuation_date
fields.validation_rule: Required when status = 'completed'. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). The date the property was valued (inspection date for physical valuations; report date for AVM). Valuation must be no older than 3 months at time of mortgage completion.

fields.name: surveyor_id
fields.validation_rule: Required for physical valuations. Identifier of the appointed RICS-qualified surveyor or AVM provider. References SVC-002 external surveyor panel. 'AVM' for automated desktop valuations.

fields.name: valuation_type
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: desktop | drive_by | full. 'desktop': AVM automated model (typically LTV < 60%, standard property type). 'drive_by': external visual inspection only (LTV 60–75%, no access to interior). 'full': RICS HomeBuyer Survey or Building Survey (LTV > 75%, non-standard construction, or surveyor discretion).

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: instructed | in_progress | completed | failed | cancelled. 'failed': surveyor unable to access property or complete valuation. 'cancelled': application withdrawn before valuation completed.

fields.name: down_valuation_flag
fields.validation_rule: Required when status = 'completed'. Computed: true if valuation_amount < MortgageApplication.purchase_price. Triggers EX-001 (Down-Valuation) exception path notification.

fields.name: report_reference
fields.validation_rule: Optional. External report reference number from the surveying firm. Stored for cross-reference with surveyor's records.

fields.name: instructed_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Set when ValuationInstructed (EVT-024) is published. Immutable.

fields.name: completed_at
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. Set when ValuationCompleted (EVT-025) is published. Null until status = 'completed'.

relationships.description: PropertyValuation belongs to one MortgageApplication via application_id FK.

entities.name: MortgageOffer
entities.description: The formal mortgage offer issued to the customer following underwriting approval (PH-014). The offer document sets out binding terms: loan amount, interest rate, term, conditions. The customer has a 7-day reflection period before acceptance. The offer is valid for 6 months from issue date.

fields.name: offer_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated. Immutable.

fields.name: application_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → MortgageApplication.application_id (ENT-012). Immutable.

fields.name: offered_amount
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, max 2 decimal places, GBP. The loan amount the bank is prepared to lend. Must be <= loan_amount requested on MortgageApplication (may be lower if affordability requires reduction). Immutable.

fields.name: offered_rate
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal expressed as annual percentage rate (%). The initial interest rate applicable to the mortgage product. Immutable.

fields.name: apr
fields.validation_rule: Required. Annual Percentage Rate (APR) inclusive of all fees and charges over the term of the mortgage. Expressed as a percentage. Computed per FCA MCOB 10 prescribed formula. Immutable.

fields.name: offer_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). The date the offer was issued to the customer. Immutable. Used as start of 7-day reflection period and 6-month validity calculation.

fields.name: expiry_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. Computed: offer_date + 6 months. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). If not accepted by expiry_date, offer lapses and MortgageApplication.status transitions to 'offer_expired'.

fields.name: conditions
fields.validation_rule: Optional. List of conditions that must be satisfied before completion. Examples: 'Buildings insurance in place at completion', 'Life assurance policy assigned to lender'. Each condition is a string, max 500 characters.

fields.name: customer_accepted
fields.validation_rule: Required. Default: false. Set to true when customer formally accepts the offer. Cannot be set to true before offer_date + 7 days (7-day reflection period per MCOB 6.7) unless written waiver is recorded.

fields.name: accepted_date
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when customer_accepted = true. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be >= offer_date + 7 days (reflection period) and <= expiry_date.

fields.name: monthly_payment
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, max 2 decimal places, GBP. Monthly repayment amount at the offered_rate for the full term. Computed by SVC-002 amortisation engine. Immutable.

relationships.description: MortgageOffer belongs to one MortgageApplication via application_id FK.
MortgageOffer is the source for one MortgageAccount created at completion (PH-015).

design_decisions.decision: The 7-day reflection period is enforced at the data layer: customer_accepted cannot be set to true before offer_date + 7 days. The API validates this constraint and returns a 422 Unprocessable Entity if a premature acceptance is attempted.
design_decisions.rationale: MCOB 6.7 compliance — the reflection period is a mandatory regulatory requirement. Enforcing it at the data layer rather than only at the UI layer ensures compliance regardless of channel or API caller.

entities.name: MortgageAccount
entities.description: The live mortgage account created at completion (PH-015) when CHAPS funds are released and legal title transfers. Represents the ongoing mortgage liability on the bank's books. Owned by SVC-002. Linked to the customer's current account (ENT-004) in SVC-001 for direct debit collection.

fields.name: account_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → Customer.customer_id (ENT-001, SVC-001). Immutable. Used for direct debit mandate linkage and correspondence.

fields.name: mortgage_offer_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → MortgageOffer.offer_id (ENT-015). Immutable. The offer from which this account was created. Used for audit trail linking back to full application history.

fields.name: property_address
fields.validation_rule: Required. Same structure as MortgageApplication.property_address. Copied from PropertyValuation at completion. Represents the secured property address.

fields.name: outstanding_balance
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal or 0.00, max 2 decimal places, GBP. Initial value: offered_amount from MortgageOffer. Reduced by each monthly repayment principal component. Updated monthly by SVC-002 mortgage ledger process. 0.00 when mortgage is fully redeemed.

fields.name: monthly_payment
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, max 2 decimal places, GBP. Monthly repayment amount. Initially equal to MortgageOffer.monthly_payment. Updated when rate changes (variable/tracker) or after partial overpayment recalculation.

fields.name: rate
fields.validation_rule: Required. Current interest rate as annual percentage (%). Initially equal to MortgageOffer.offered_rate. Updated when initial fixed period ends and reverts to SVR, or when tracker rate moves with base rate.

fields.name: term_remaining
fields.validation_rule: Required. Remaining term in months. Initially = term_years × 12. Decremented monthly. Zero when mortgage is fully redeemed.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: active | arrears | redeemed. 'active': performing mortgage, payments up to date. 'arrears': one or more missed payments — MCOB 13 arrears management applies. 'redeemed': mortgage fully repaid or transferred. Transitions: active → arrears (missed payment); arrears → active (arrears cleared); active|arrears → redeemed (full redemption).

fields.name: opened_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). The completion date. Immutable.

fields.name: next_payment_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Date of next scheduled direct debit collection. Updated monthly after each successful payment.

fields.name: direct_debit_reference
fields.validation_rule: Required. Bacs direct debit mandate reference. Unique. Links to the customer's nominated current account (sort code + account number) for monthly payment collection.

fields.name: chaps_payment_reference
fields.validation_rule: Required. The CHAPS payment reference under which completion funds were released. Immutable. Used for reconciliation with the CHAPS settlement record.

relationships.description: MortgageAccount belongs to one Customer via customer_id FK.
MortgageAccount was created from one MortgageOffer via mortgage_offer_id FK.

MortgageAccount direct debit collection targets an Account (ENT-004, SVC-001). Reference held as sort code + account number for Bacs mandate. SVC-002 does not hold a direct FK to ENT-004 account_id — the Bacs mandate is the integration point.

design_decisions.decision: outstanding_balance is stored as a field on MortgageAccount and updated monthly rather than derived from transaction ledger.
design_decisions.rationale: Mortgages are amortising loans with a defined repayment schedule. The outstanding balance is a well-defined computed value updated on a known schedule (monthly payment processing). Unlike a current account (where balance is a continuous ledger computation), mortgage outstanding balance is updated in a controlled batch process. Storing it directly supports efficient account servicing and customer queries without ledger traversal.
